sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् राघवेण महात्मना ।सीताया भाषितं सर्वं न्यवेदयत राघवे ।। ५.६७.१ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktastu hanumān rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।sītāyā bhāṣitaṁ sarvaṁ nyavedayata rāghave ।। 5.67.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Thus asked by Sri Rama, Hanuman repeated everything spoken by Sita to Rama.
